name: Shri Ahimsa Naturals Ltd
tagline: Rs ~900 Cr small-cap natural-caffeine and botanical-extract maker (claims Asia's largest natural-caffeine capacity) -- ROCE ~24%, debt-free, ~18% revenue CAGR on a tiny ~Rs 123 Cr base -- backward-integrating and trebling capacity, but a niche semi-commoditised export product at ~45x earnings
business_overview: Shri Ahimsa Naturals (NSE: SHRIAHIMSA) extracts natural caffeine from green coffee beans / tea waste and produces allied botanical extracts and nutraceutical ingredients, sold largely to global beverage, pharma, cosmetics and supplement customers. The pitch is scale leadership in natural (vs synthetic Chinese) caffeine plus a 3x capacity expansion and backward integration toward a fully integrated extraction chain.
fundamentals_table: ~40-45x earnings on a small PAT base
fundamentals_narrative: Return ratios are genuinely good and the balance sheet is clean, but the absolute base is tiny (~Rs 123 Cr revenue) and growth (~18% CAGR) is solid-not-explosive. Natural caffeine is a niche, semi-commoditised ingredient with meaningful customer and geography concentration and FX / export-demand sensitivity; 'Asia's largest' is a capacity claim, not a pricing moat. The 3x capacity expansion plus backward integration is the real catalyst -- if it lands on schedule and fills, revenue and margins step up; if global caffeine pricing stays soft or a key customer shifts, the new capacity sits idle.

four_box score 1.5 -> 'neither' (hard). tailwind weak (clean-label caffeine demand real but not an accelerating structural pull), tam weak (small global natural-caffeine niche, ~Rs 900 Cr mcap already), moat weak (capacity scale, not pricing power; concentration risk), valuation no (~45x on a tiny PAT).
